title: Colombia’s Trump-Endorsed President-Elect Was Once Investigated by U.S. Authorities
summary_full: While living in Miami, Colombia’s president-elect represented accused drug traffickers and money launderers. He himself was investigated by U.S. authorities, though never charged.
